summary: The extraction is accurate. All four theorems (five bounds) are recorded with the correct expressions, constants, high-probability qualifier, horizon and tuning. The settings and algorithm registry ids are consistent with the paper. Lemma 1 and Corollary 1 are technical concentration results and were rightly skipped.
